verdict.rationale: Cline's own docs show it reading the codebase and running searches by itself in Plan mode, and spawning subagents that explore the codebase independently and report back, so you don't have to hand-pick context files. However, nothing documents mapping or explaining an entire codebase end to end. A community comment also notes Cline does not index the codebase, which is a design note rather than a concrete failure. missing for 10: documented whole-codebase mapping or overview capability, evidence of how it scales to large unfamiliar repos, hands-on corroboration of codebase-explanation quality.

support.subject: As a developer, I can have the agent map and explain an entire unfamiliar codebase without manually selecting context files

citations.quote: In this mode, Cline can read your codebase, run searches, and discuss strategy, but cannot modify any files or execute commands.
Each subagent gets its own prompt and context window, explores the codebase independently, and returns a detailed report to the main agent.
